children: Shares of HDFC Bank were trading marginally higher on Wednesday, up 0.41 per cent at ₹741.65 as of 12.20 pm, after opening at ₹735.65 on the NSE.

The stock touched an intraday high of ₹742.80 and a low of ₹734.00, with traded volume at 131.70 lakh shares and a traded value of ₹973.48 crore. Total market capitalisation stood at ₹11.43 lakh crore.
Sell-side pressure remains visible, with 68.75 per cent of the order book on the sell side against 31.25 per cent on the buy side.

title: HDFC Bank shares edge higher on UBS Buy call; Q2 results in focus
